children: Germany’s seasonally adjusted unemployment rate held steady at 6.4% in August 2026, in line with expectations and remaining at its highest level since 2020.
The number of unemployed rose by a slightly smaller-than-expected 4,000 to 2.996 million, just below the politically significant 3 million mark.
On a non-seasonally adjusted basis, unemployment remained above 3 million for a second consecutive month, rising by 36,260 to 3.061 million.
Labor Office head Andrea Nahles said the labor market showed “little momentum” beyond normal seasonal patterns, continuing the subdued trend seen in recent months.
Unemployment typically rises from July due to the summer break, while Germany’s sluggish economy has added to labor-market weakness.
However, recent signs of stronger economic growth could provide some support in the months ahead.

title: German Unemployment Holds at 2020 High
